comment: PlayerStates' cook recipe: run on each player's machine (kiln cook), reading the installed game; it writes assets/cooked/ (never committed). The source is assets/src/riposte.gltf, made by make_assets.py: the sample's own rig and the motion of its sword arm, no game data. Read from the game: the player's skeleton (the arm is retargeted onto it) and the clips of the three game states ours are placed like (assets/player-states.json). Each of our clips is that game clip with the sword arm taken from ours, so the body moves as the game moves it.

sword_attack.comment: the clip of Attack_Sword_Shield_01, the first sword attack (1.667 s)

sword_heavy.comment: the clip of the sword machine's Attack_Heavy (2.567 s)

block.comment: the clip of Block_FullBody, a loop (6.65 s)

steps.comment: the sample's sword arm, authored on its own rig, played on the player's skeleton. The map is the rig's joint -> the player's joint (j<index>). These clips only feed the next step

the clips the states play: the game's clip (with its root motion and events) and our sword arm on it, from the shoulder down to the hand: j70 and j71 the upper arm, j72 and j73 the forearm, j74 the hand. The fingers keep the game's grip
